reviewItem.question: For "`envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_init_fetch_timeout` -> `envoy_cilium_npds_init_fetch_timeout`", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether external dashboards, alerts or recording rules query the metric envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_init_fetch_timeout

proposed.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the Envoy metric `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_init_fetch_timeout` is renamed to `envoy_cilium_npds_init_fetch_timeout`, so monitoring that queries the old name needs to be checked.
